BlockAlphanumericSenders.compatibility: Supports iOS 15 and 16 with Dopamine 2 rootless. No native RootHide package has been released.

BlockAppUpdates.compatibility: Targets iOS 15 and later on rootless and native RootHide jailbreaks. Private LaunchServices behavior may vary by iOS version and jailbreak. Version 1.0.3 executable payloads and installer scripts are preserved from ichitaso's published builds; no additional device testing by sahinkaa is claimed.
BlockAppUpdates.author: sahinkaa • ichitaso

changes: Show each application's version next to its name in the Settings list, as in 1.0.0's original design.
Fall back to the bundle name when an application's display name is empty, fixing applications listed without a name.

Re-register jailbreak, TrollStore and TrollStore Lite applications after the LaunchServices rebuild, fixing apps that stopped launching, lost their icon labels, disappeared or ran letterboxed after committing changes.
Finish committing as soon as LaunchServices reflects the changed applications instead of always waiting at least 60 seconds (about 15–30 seconds in total on iOS 15-26).
Restart `appstored` together with App Store so blocked and unblocked applications appear correctly in the update list.
Fit application icons to the Settings list rows.
Initial public release.
Selectively blocks and restores App Store updates per application.
Supports staging multiple changes and applying one LaunchServices refresh.
Separates blocked updates from available applications.
Excludes TrollStore-installed applications.
Detects reinstalled applications and clears obsolete blocked metadata.
Supports rootless iOS 15 and later on arm64 and arm64e devices.
Requests Restart SpringBoard after installation, upgrade and removal.

NeverLowerMusic16.author: Rishanan • sahinkaa

NoHomeBar26.compatibility: Targets iOS 26. Other iOS versions are not claimed compatible.

NoShutterAndScreenshotSounds.compatibility: Targets iOS 15-26. Tested on iOS 16 rootless and iPhone 11 Pro Max, iOS 26.0.1, Dopamine 3 RootHide. Other versions in the range have not been individually tested.

SystemInfoDisplayFix.compatibility: iOS / iPadOS 16.x only. Requires the specific compatible System Info binary described in the GitHub README. Rootless package; RootHide requires conversion. No native RootHide release.

Tinge26.compatibility: Requires iOS 26. Tested on iPhone 11 Pro Max, iOS 26.0.1, Dopamine 3 RootHide.

changes: Reuse cached icon colors when a new badge appears.
Preserve the same icon's sampled color through badge count changes.
Retry unavailable icon pixels early with a bounded recovery sequence.
Keep valid background paint visible while the same icon's appearance refreshes.
Reject stale callbacks after view reuse or a folder's highest-count app changes.
Preserve static badge backgrounds, text colors, borders, highest-count folder coloring and safe animated badge updates.
